author: Sloan Digital Sky Survey / BOSS
note: Actual BOSS galaxy redshifts from SDSS DR17 in a 150 by 150 by 40 Mpc comoving slice centered at RA=180 degrees, Dec=20 degrees, z=0.475. Positions use flat LCDM with H0=70 km/s/Mpc and Omega_m=0.27. This is a survey sample spanning the approximate BAO separation scale, not an individual acoustic shell or an identified BAO structure. The BAO excess requires a statistical pair-correlation measurement across a much larger sample and cannot be inferred by eye from this patch. Colors encode redshift, not galaxy color. All points come from the catalog; no patterns are imposed.

operations: Direct conversion of hash-pinned public catalog coordinates; physical units retained.
Native units: Mpc; 141 distinct source records.
One soft point per selected record; no generated geometry, rulers, random depths or filler stars.
